story_type: helicopter landing on an offshore facility, camera mounted outside the aircraft
hook: A camera bolted outside a helicopter, landing 95 miles out at sea.
narration: This camera rode on the outside of a Coast Guard helicopter as it touched down ninety-five miles out at sea.
The deck belonged to the Helix Producer One, a floating offshore facility south of Port Fourchon, Louisiana.
A fifty-six-year-old man aboard needed to get to a hospital.
If a helideck is built to take the helicopter's weight, the crew can land and load the patient by hand, with no hoist at all.
[short pause] He walked out and climbed aboard.
outcome: Then the Jayhawk lifted off the deck with him inside.

location_card.place: 95 miles south of Port Fourchon, Louisiana

title: Helicopter cam lands 95 miles out at sea
description:
A Coast Guard Air Station New Orleans MH-60 Jayhawk aircrew medevaced a 56-year-old man from the floating outer continental shelf facility Helix Producer 1, about 95 miles south of Port Fourchon, Louisiana, filmed from a camera on the outside of the helicopter.
